description: Export list. Export all items from a completed list. The list must have status "completed" before export. Credits are charged per record. Set estimate_cost=true to quote the export without starting it. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

anchor.description: Row anchor. Property lists default to person so exports return property-owner contact rows. Use property for property-only rows.

estimate_cost.description: When true, returns the export's row count and a credit quote without creating a file or spending credits. The quote reads the entities this export would bill and subtracts the ones already billed in the current billing cycle. Send the same request without estimate_cost to run the export.

require_phone.description: Only include people with a phone number on a person-anchored export.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_post_lists_list_id_export
